intelligence.enrichment: Humans benefit from ecosystems because ecosystem components depend on each other and support life processes while providing useful resources and services. Interactions among biotic and abiotic components sustain ecosystem functions, and those functions provide benefits to people. The learner correctly applies this rule: Humans benefit from ecosystems because ecosystem components depend on each other and support life processes while providing useful resources and services. Ecosystems matter to humans only when people build or manage them for direct use.
